source_evidence: Many people choose to invest their contributions in a mutual fund or exchange-traded fund (ETF).
answer: An exchange-traded fund (ETF) is presented here as one option for investing contributions in a retirement account. After you contribute, you choose how to invest that money; many people choose a mutual fund or an ETF. The source does not explain how ETFs are structured or traded, so this introduction is limited to their role as an investment option.
